label: Create a payment request
description: Create a new payment request for a Brevo contact. The request requires a reference (displayed on the payment page), a contact ID, and a cart with currency and amount in cents. You can optionally configure a custom success redirect URL and enable email notifications with reminders. Returns the payment request ID and its public payment URL. A `403` error is returned if Brevo Payments is not activated or the account is not validated.

cart.description: Specify the payment currency and amount.

currency.description: Currency code for the payment amount.

specificAmount.description: Payment amount, in cents. e.g. if you want to request €12.00, then the amount in cents is 1200.

configuration.description: Optional. Redirect contact to a custom success page once payment is successful. If empty the default Brevo page will be displayed once a payment is validated

customSuccessUrl.description: Absolute URL of the custom success page.

contactId.description: Brevo ID of the contact requested to pay.

description.example: Shipping Cost for sending bottles to NYC

notification.description: Optional. Use this object if you want to let Brevo send an email to the contact, with the payment request URL. If empty, no notifications (message and reminders) will be sent.

channel.description: Channel used to send the notifications.

text.description: Use this field if you want to give more context to your contact about the payment request.
text.example: Please pay for your yoga class.

reference.description: Reference of the payment request, it will appear on the payment page.

url.description: URL of the payment request created

preconditions: Brevo Payments activated (needed before any call in this area)

postcondition.assert: the entity exists and its fields equal the inputs that were sent

requires: turn this feature on in the account first
availability.evidence: HTTP 403: the feature is not turned on

verification.notes: HTTP 403 to a call with inputs that cannot succeed: {"message": "Payment is not activated for user", "code": "permission_denied"}
